questions.question: What are the two basic voltage levels represented in binary digital circuits?
Which logic gate produces output 1 only when all its inputs are 1?
Which logic gate produces output 1 when at least one input is 1?
Which logic gate is also called an inverter?
Why is the NAND gate called a 'universal gate'?
options: Any Boolean function can be implemented using only NAND gates
It operates at universal voltage levels
It can accept an infinite number of inputs
questions.answer: Any Boolean function can be implemented using only NAND gates
